Method of Attack: Bundled with legitimate Zoom client installer to mine Monero cryptocurrency using victim's GPU and CPU
Bundled with Zoom client installer to install Remote Access Trojan giving attacker full access to victim's computer
Remote Access Trojan allowing attacker to steal data, take webcam screenshots, execute commands to download/install other malware
Attack Vector: Downloading Zoom client installer from fraudulent websites instead of official Zoom download center
Malicious Zoom installers distributed targeting users (e.g., German users) with unwanted software bundles or RATs
Indicators of Compromise: Zoom installers not from official Zoom download center
Malicious files bundled with Zoom client installers
Presence of cryptocurrency miner and Remote Access Trojan in installer packages
